desc:
🏠 Welcome to House 13

An emergency broadcast warns of "Impostors", things that take the shape of people. They wear their clothes, imitate their voices, and they will ask to be let in.

Can you help fleeing strangers in need survive the night, or will you open the door to something that isn't a person?

📼 Set years before Terminal 13. Find out where the Impostors came from.
⚠️ Contains horror elements such as disturbing visuals, tension, and loud sounds.
🎧 Headphones & max graphics recommended for full immersion.

❓ Will you make it to morning… or be collected before the knocking stops?
